title: Viniyoga of mitrasya

words.role: first word of the mantra quoted

words.meaning: thus; marks the words before it as a quotation

words.gram: compound, n. loc. sg. (M’s spelling of प्रातःसन्ध्योपस्थाने)
words.meaning: in the upasthāna of the morning sandhyā

words.role: what the mantra is used for

translation.literal: Of the mantra “mitrasya”: the All-gods the seers, gāyatrī and triṣṭubh the metres, Mitra the deity, the use in the morning sandhyā upasthāna.
translation.readable: Mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ: seers the All-gods, metres gāyatrī and triṣṭubh, deity Mitra; used for the morning upasthāna.

sandhi_exceptions.note: The prayoga leaves two vowels side by side across a phrase boundary of the formula, without joining them.

meaning: A viniyoga is the statement said before a mantra of its seer (ṛṣi), its metre (chandas), its deity (devatā) and the use (viniyoga) it is put to. Here: the three ṛks to Mitra (TS 3.4.11.5; RV 3.59.6, 1, 2), the morning upasthāna. The first is a gāyatrī and the other two triṣṭubhs, which is why two metres are named. The commas of the witness mark the pauses between the parts; a word before a comma keeps its pausal form, so the comma is written with the word in the padaccheda.
in_the_rite: Morning service, step surya-upasthana, before mitrasya (M only).

flags.text: M writes सन्धोपस्थाने for सन्ध्योपस्थाने. A correction should be considered.
